reviewed_by: Claude, based on an independently validated root cause and a scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Automatic dead-owner recovery no longer waits on every unowned execution process; it holds a project's recovery only while an unowned process still holds that project's open resource, unfinished command or held capacity. The selected tests cover an idle stray that neither blocks nor is reused, a stray holding the project's effects that still blocks, another project's leftover that does not block, and the existing lost-prepare no-replay case, on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, frontend, native or browser changes. The admission path is unchanged, so admission suites are not selected; tests/v3/test_admission_retry.py was run locally and passes.
